name: Dezhan Healthcare Company Limited
summary: Dezhan Healthcare Company Limited engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs in the People's Republic of China. The company offers atorvastatin calcium tablets, amlodipine-atorvastatin calcium tablets, warfarin sodium tablets, trimetazidine hydrochloride tablets, amiodarone hydrochloride tablets, as well as other drugs, including famciclovir tablets, azathioprine tablets, hydroxyurea tablets, colchicine tablet, and oseltamivir phosphate capsules.
